name: szamlazo
description: Self-hosted Hungarian invoicing with NAV Online Számla reporting

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @szamlazo/invoicing && npm run build -w @szamlazo/nav
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @szamlazo/server
scripts.check: npm run build:libs && npm run check --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && tsx watch --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/server/src/index.ts
